name: Anton
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The **Hotel Anton** is located in **St. Anton am Arlberg**, right next to the base station of the **Nassereinbahn**. The town center is just a few minutes' walk away. It is classified as a **Four-Star Superior Hotel**, blending modern design with alpine materials. The culinary offerings include a **restaurant** and a **wine bar**. The **1,300-square-meter** wellness area features multiple saunas, a steam bath, and a relaxation pool. The rooms and suites are furnished with native woods and natural stone. In winter, guests have direct access to the slopes, while in summer, the house serves as a base for hiking and mountain biking tours.
